files.assistant.py:
"""The assistant coach: reads the state of the club and points out what
deserves the coach's attention this week.

Every tip is ``{"level": "warn" | "info" | "good", "text": ..., "go": screen}``
where ``go`` names the app screen that deals with it.  The heuristics mirror
how the match engine actually works, so the advice is worth following.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from . import constants as C
from . import offseason, season, views
from .models import Game
from .ratings import (overall, ovr, available, lineup_problems, auto_select, raw_rating,
                      shown_potential, form_value)


def _avg(xs):
    xs = list(xs)
    return sum(xs) / len(xs) if xs else 0.0


def _field(game: Game, cid: str):
    club = game.clubs[cid]
    return {s: game.players[pid] for s, pid in club.lineup.items()
            if s in C.FIELD_SLOTS and pid in game.players}


def matchup_notes(game: Game, cid: str, opp_id: str) -> list[dict]:
    """Tactical reads on the next opponent."""
    me, opp = game.clubs[cid], game.clubs[opp_id]
    mine, theirs = _field(game, cid), _field(game, opp_id)
    if len(mine) < 18 or len(theirs) < 18:
        return []
    tips = []
    skill = _avg(0.6 * p.attrs["kicking"] + 0.4 * p.attrs["decision"] for p in mine.values())
    their_backs = [theirs[s] for s in ("BPL", "FB", "BPR", "HBL", "CHB", "HBR")]
    zoneq = _avg(0.5 * p.attrs["intercept"] + 0.5 * p.attrs["decision"] for p in their_backs)
    if opp.tactics["defence"] == "zone":
        if skill >= zoneq + 0.4:
            tips.append({"level": "good", "go": "plan", "text":
                         f"{opp.name} zone off, but your ball use is good enough to pick it apart. "
                         f"An outside style or fast tempo should find targets."})
        elif skill <= zoneq - 0.4:
            tips.append({"level": "warn", "go": "plan", "text":
                         f"{opp.name}'s zone will feast on loose kicks. Go contested and bring the ball "
                         f"to ground - a small forward line helps."})
    r_me = raw_rating(mine["RUCK"].attrs, "RUCK") * 5
    r_opp = raw_rating(theirs["RUCK"].attrs, "RUCK") * 5
    if r_me - r_opp >= 7:
        tips.append({"level": "good", "go": "plan", "text":
                     f"{mine['RUCK'].short} should dominate the ruck ({r_me:.0f} v {r_opp:.0f}). "
                     f"A contested, stoppage-heavy game cashes that in."})
    elif r_opp - r_me >= 7:
        tips.append({"level": "warn", "go": "plan", "text":
                     f"You will lose the hit-outs ({theirs['RUCK'].short} {r_opp:.0f} v {r_me:.0f}). "
                     f"Keep it moving: an outside style means fewer stoppages decide the game."})
    my_talls = _avg(raw_rating(mine[s].attrs, C.FIELD_SLOTS[s]) for s in ("FB", "CHB")) * 5
    their_talls = _avg(raw_rating(theirs[s].attrs, C.FIELD_SLOTS[s]) for s in ("FF", "CHF")) * 5
    if their_talls - my_talls >= 6 and me.tactics["defence"] == "man":
        tips.append({"level": "warn", "go": "plan", "text":
                     f"Their key forwards ({their_talls:.0f}) have your key backs ({my_talls:.0f}) covered "
                     f"one-on-one. A zone or a loose man would give them help."})
    my_mid = views.line_ratings(game, cid)["M"]
    their_mid = views.line_ratings(game, opp_id)["M"]
    if their_mid - my_mid >= 5 and me.tactics["defence"] != "loose":
        tips.append({"level": "info", "go": "plan", "text":
                     f"Their midfield ({their_mid:.0f}) is well on top of yours ({my_mid:.0f}) on paper. "
                     f"Expect to defend a lot of entries - a loose man behind the ball limits the damage."})
    if opp.tactics["pressure"] == "high" and me.tactics["style"] == "outside" and skill < 14.5:
        tips.append({"level": "warn", "go": "plan", "text":
                     f"{opp.name} bring manic pressure and your outside game needs clean hands you "
                     f"don't quite have. Consider a balanced or contested style this week."})
    return tips[:3]


def advice(game: Game) -> list[dict]:
    club = game.user
    if not club:
        return []
    cid = club.id
    tips = []
    squad = game.squad(cid)
    ph = game.phase
    manual = game.meta.get("selection", "auto") == "manual"

    if ph in ("season", "finals"):
        for prob in lineup_problems(game, cid)[:2]:
            tips.append({"level": "warn", "go": "team", "text": f"Team sheet: {prob}."})
        named = {pid for pid in club.lineup.values()}
        picked = [game.players[pid] for pid in named if pid in game.players]
        if manual and picked:
            floor = min(overall(p) for p in picked)
            knock = sorted((p for p in squad if p.id not in named and available(p)
                            and overall(p) >= floor + 3), key=overall, reverse=True)[:3]
            if knock:
                tips.append({"level": "info", "go": "team", "text":
                             "Banging the door down: " + ", ".join(f"{p.short} ({p.pos} {ovr(p)})" for p in knock)
                             + ". You are picking the side, so nobody is recalled unless you do it."})
        tired = [p for p in picked if p.fitness < 78]
        if len(tired) >= 3:
            tips.append({"level": "warn", "go": "plan", "text":
                         f"{len(tired)} of your 23 are under 78% fitness ("
                         + ", ".join(p.short for p in sorted(tired, key=lambda p: p.fitness)[:4])
                         + "). A light or recovery week, or a rest for the worst of them, will help."})
        avg_fit = _avg(p.fitness for p in picked)
        if avg_fit < 86 and (club.tactics["pressure"] == "high" or club.training.get("intensity") == "heavy"):
            tips.append({"level": "warn", "go": "plan", "text":
                         f"The list is running on fumes (average fitness {avg_fit:.0f}%). "
                         f"High pressure and heavy training together are costing you late in games."})
        m = season.next_match(game, cid)
        if m:
            opp_id = m["away"] if m["home"] == cid else m["home"]
            if opp_id != cid:
                game.clubs[opp_id].lineup = auto_select(
                    game, opp_id, 0.25 if game.clubs[opp_id].strategy == "rebuild" else 0.0)
            tips += matchup_notes(game, cid, opp_id)
        kids = sorted((p for p in squad if p.id not in named and p.age <= 21 and available(p)
                       and p.reserves >= 7.3 and shown_potential(game, p) >= 80),
                      key=lambda p: -p.reserves)[:2]
        for p in kids:
            tips.append({"level": "info", "go": f"player/{p.id}", "text":
                         f"{p.name} ({p.age}, potential {shown_potential(game, p)}) rated {p.reserves} in the "
                         f"reserves. Senior games would speed up his development."})
        hot = [p for p in picked if len(p.form) >= 3 and form_value(p) >= 7.6]
        if hot:
            best = max(hot, key=form_value)
            tips.append({"level": "good", "go": f"player/{best.id}", "text":
                         f"{best.name} is in career-best touch: averaging {form_value(best):.1f} over his last "
                         f"{len(best.form)}."})

    ooc = sorted(offseason.out_of_contract(game, cid), key=overall, reverse=True)
    key_ooc = [p for p in ooc if overall(p) >= 72 or shown_potential(game, p) >= 80]
    if ph == "contracts" and ooc:
        tips.append({"level": "warn", "go": "contracts", "text":
                     f"{len(ooc)} player(s) are unsigned and will walk when the signing period ends"
                     + (": " + ", ".join(f"{p.short} ({ovr(p)})" for p in key_ooc[:4]) if key_ooc else "") + "."})
    elif ph == "season" and game.meta["round"] >= 12 and key_ooc:
        tips.append({"level": "info", "go": "contracts", "text":
                     "Out of contract this year: " + ", ".join(f"{p.short} ({ovr(p)})" for p in key_ooc[:4])
                     + ". You can re-sign them now."})
    room = offseason.cap_space(game, cid)
    if room < 0:
        tips.append({"level": "warn", "go": "contracts", "text":
                     f"You are {views.money(-room)} over the salary cap."})
    elif ph in ("trades", "draft") and room > game.cap * 0.06:
        tips.append({"level": "info", "go": "agents", "text":
                     f"You have {views.money(room)} of cap room to use on free agents or a trade."})
    if ph == "draft":
        slot = offseason.draft_on_clock(game)
        if slot and slot["owner"] == cid:
            tips.append({"level": "warn", "go": "draft", "text":
                         f"You are on the clock with pick {slot['n']}."})
    if ph in ("trades", "draft"):
        senior, rookies = offseason.list_counts(game, cid)
        if senior + rookies >= C.LIST_MAX:
            tips.append({"level": "info", "go": "contracts", "text":
                         "Your list is full (44). You cannot draft or sign anyone until you delist or trade."})
    inj = [p for p in squad if p.injury]
    if len(inj) >= 5:
        tips.append({"level": "info", "go": "squad", "text":
                     f"{len(inj)} players are on the injury list. Lighter training lowers the risk of more."})
    conf = club.board["confidence"]
    if conf < 30:
        tips.append({"level": "warn", "go": "club", "text":
                     f"The board is close to making a change (confidence {conf:.0f}/100). Wins are the only cure."})
    return tips[:7]

"""Club finances and the board.

Deliberately simple for now: a round-by-round ledger of the big income and
expense lines (all in $k), gate receipts driven by crowds, and a board whose
confidence in you moves with results measured against what they expected.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import math

from . import constants as C
from .models import Game, Club
from .ratings import best22_rating

PRIZE_MONEY = {"Premier": 1200, "Runner-up": 660, "Preliminary final": 300,
               "Semi final": 150, "Elimination final": 75}


def _add(club: Club, key: str, amount: float) -> None:
    amount = int(round(amount))
    club.ledger[key] = club.ledger.get(key, 0) + amount
    club.last_ledger[key] = club.last_ledger.get(key, 0) + amount
    club.balance += amount


def match_day(game: Game, m: dict, rng) -> int:
    """Work out the crowd and bank the gate for the home club."""
    from .season import ladder
    home, away = game.clubs[m["home"]], game.clubs[m["away"]]
    vstate, capacity = C.VENUES[m["venue"]][0], C.VENUES[m["venue"]][1]
    final = not isinstance(m["rnd"], int)
    crowd = home.supporters * (0.40 if home.state == vstate else 0.10)
    crowd += away.supporters * (0.22 if away.state == vstate else 0.03)
    pos = {r["club"]: r["pos"] for r in ladder(game)}
    for cid in (home.id, away.id):
        crowd *= 1.10 if pos[cid] <= 4 else 0.92 if pos[cid] >= 15 else 1.0
    if m.get("wet"):
        crowd *= 0.9
    crowd *= 1000 * rng.uniform(0.85, 1.15)
    if final:
        crowd = capacity * (1.0 if m["rnd"] == "GF" else rng.uniform(0.8, 1.0))
    att = int(min(capacity, crowd))
    home.last_ledger = {}
    away.last_ledger = {}
    # finals gates go to the league; clubs get prize money instead
    if not final:
        _add(home, "gate", att * 0.014)
    return att


def weekly(game: Game) -> None:
    """Per-round share of the season-long income and expense lines."""
    n = C.HA_ROUNDS
    scale = game.cap / C.SALARY_CAP              # everything inflates with the cap
    for cid, club in game.clubs.items():
        s = club.supporters
        _add(club, "membership", s * 190 / n * scale)
        _add(club, "sponsorship", (9000 + s * 90) / n * scale)
        _add(club, "afl_distribution", (13500 + max(0.0, 80 - s) * 170) / n * scale)
        _add(club, "player_payments", -game.payroll(cid) / n)
        _add(club, "football_dept", -9000 / n * scale)
        _add(club, "operations", -(7000 + s * 215) / n * scale)


def profit(club: Club) -> int:
    return sum(club.ledger.values())


# -- the board -----------------------------------------------------------------
def set_board_expectations(game: Game) -> None:
    """Expectations follow list quality: the better the list, the higher the bar."""
    ranking = sorted(game.clubs, key=lambda c: best22_rating(game, c), reverse=True)
    for i, cid in enumerate(ranking):
        rank = i + 1
        target = 4 if rank <= 3 else 8 if rank <= 7 else 12 if rank <= 12 else 16
        label = next(lbl for pos, lbl in C.BOARD_TIERS if target <= pos)
        b = game.clubs[cid].board
        b["target"], b["label"], b["list_rank"] = target, label, rank
        # a new season softens the mood either way, but the board has a memory
        b["confidence"] = round(min(85.0, max(15.0, 0.65 * b.get("confidence", 60.0) + 0.35 * 55.0)), 1)


def win_probability(game: Game, home_id: str, away_id: str) -> float:
    """Rough pre-game expectation, used by the board and the match preview."""
    diff = best22_rating(game, home_id) - best22_rating(game, away_id)
    return 1.0 / (1.0 + math.exp(-(0.30 * diff + 0.15)))


def board_after_match(game: Game, m: dict) -> None:
    user = game.meta.get("user_club")
    if user not in (m["home"], m["away"]):
        return
    p_home = win_probability(game, m["home"], m["away"])
    hp, ap = m["hs"][2], m["as"][2]
    res_home = 1.0 if hp > ap else 0.5 if hp == ap else 0.0
    exp, res = (p_home, res_home) if user == m["home"] else (1 - p_home, 1 - res_home)
    final = not isinstance(m["rnd"], int)
    b = game.clubs[user].board
    b["confidence"] = round(max(0.0, min(100.0, b["confidence"] + 4.5 * (res - exp) * (1.6 if final else 1.0))), 1)


def season_review(game: Game) -> dict:
    """End-of-year verdict for the user plus prize money for everyone."""
    from .season import finals_finish
    finish = finals_finish(game)
    for cid, stage in finish.items():
        _add(game.clubs[cid], "prize_money", PRIZE_MONEY.get(stage, 0))
    club = game.user
    if not club:
        return {}
    pos = game.season["final_ladder"].index(club.id) + 1
    b = club.board
    delta = 0.0
    if pos <= b["target"]:
        delta += 6.0 + (b["target"] - pos) * 1.0
    else:
        delta -= min(35.0, 4.0 * (pos - b["target"]))
    stage = finish.get(club.id)
    delta += {"Premier": 30, "Runner-up": 14, "Preliminary final": 8, "Semi final": 4}.get(stage, 0)
    pl = profit(club)
    delta += 3.0 if pl > 1500 else -4.0 if pl < -2500 else 0.0
    b["confidence"] = round(max(0.0, min(100.0, b["confidence"] + delta)), 1)
    verdict = ("delighted" if delta >= 20 else "pleased" if delta >= 8 else "satisfied" if delta >= 0
               else "disappointed" if delta > -15 else "furious")
    # no board sacks a coach after one season; after that, lose them and you're gone
    sacked = b["confidence"] < 12.0 and game.year > game.meta.get("hired", game.year)
    return {"position": pos, "target": b["target"], "label": b["label"], "finish": stage,
            "profit": pl, "delta": round(delta, 1), "confidence": b["confidence"],
            "verdict": verdict, "sacked": sacked}

"""World generation: clubs, playing lists, draft prospects and draft picks.

All players are fictional.  Each new world shuffles which clubs are loaded
with talent and which are rebuilding, so every career starts differently;
club stature (supporter base, finances) follows the real competition.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import random

from . import constants as C
from .models import Game, Player, Club
from .names import FIRST_NAMES, LAST_NAMES
from .ratings import raw_rating, overall, best22_rating

# Fraction of his ceiling a player has typically reached at each age.
AGE_CURVE = {18: .72, 19: .77, 20: .82, 21: .865, 22: .905, 23: .94, 24: .97, 25: .99,
             26: 1.0, 27: 1.0, 28: 1.0, 29: .99, 30: .975, 31: .955, 32: .93, 33: .90,
             34: .87, 35: .84, 36: .80}
AGE_WEIGHTS = {18: 3.0, 19: 3.2, 20: 3.2, 21: 3.2, 22: 3.2, 23: 3.2, 24: 3.1, 25: 3.0,
               26: 2.9, 27: 2.7, 28: 2.5, 29: 2.2, 30: 1.9, 31: 1.4, 32: 1.0, 33: 0.6, 34: 0.3}
# A 42-man list: 4 rucks, 5 key defenders, 7 general defenders, 4 wings,
# 10 midfielders, 7 general forwards and 5 key forwards.
LIST_TEMPLATE = (["RUCK"] * 4 + ["FB"] * 2 + ["CHB"] * 3 + ["BP"] * 3 + ["HBF"] * 4 + ["W"] * 4
                 + ["C"] * 4 + ["RR"] * 3 + ["ROV"] * 3 + ["HFF"] * 4 + ["CHF"] * 3 + ["FP"] * 3
                 + ["FF"] * 2)
# Talent offsets (OVR points) dealt out at random to the 18 clubs.
STRENGTH_TIERS = [2.6, 2.1, 1.7, 1.3, 1.0, 0.7, 0.4, 0.2, 0.0, -0.2, -0.4, -0.7, -1.0,
                  -1.3, -1.7, -2.1, -2.5, -3.0]
SECONDARY = {
    "FB": [("CHB", .6)], "CHB": [("FB", .4), ("CHF", .15)], "BP": [("HBF", .5)],
    "HBF": [("BP", .3), ("W", .3), ("C", .1)], "W": [("HBF", .3), ("C", .25), ("HFF", .25)],
    "C": [("RR", .4), ("ROV", .3), ("W", .2)], "RR": [("C", .6)],
    "ROV": [("C", .4), ("FP", .3), ("HFF", .2)], "RUCK": [("FF", .25), ("CHF", .1)],
    "HFF": [("FP", .4), ("W", .25), ("ROV", .2)], "CHF": [("FF", .6), ("CHB", .1)],
    "FP": [("HFF", .4), ("ROV", .3)], "FF": [("CHF", .6), ("RUCK", .1)],
}
HEIGHTS = {"RUCK": (200, 211), "FB": (191, 200), "CHB": (191, 200), "CHF": (192, 201),
           "FF": (192, 203), "W": (180, 191), "HBF": (180, 191), "HFF": (180, 191),
           "C": (180, 192), "RR": (183, 193), "BP": (174, 186), "FP": (172, 184), "ROV": (173, 185)}
PROSPECT_POS_WEIGHTS = {"RUCK": 4, "FB": 4, "CHB": 6, "BP": 6, "HBF": 9, "W": 9, "C": 11,
                        "RR": 8, "ROV": 9, "HFF": 9, "CHF": 6, "FP": 8, "FF": 5}


def _clamp(x, lo, hi):
    return max(lo, min(hi, x))


def curve(age: int) -> float:
    return AGE_CURVE.get(age, 0.78 if age > 36 else 0.72)


def gen_attrs(rng, pos: str, target_ovr: float, age: int) -> dict:
    """Build an attribute set whose rating in ``pos`` equals ``target_ovr``."""
    t = target_ovr / 5.0
    w = C.POS_WEIGHTS[pos]
    tall = C.POS_GROUP[pos] in ("KD", "KF", "RK")
    a = {}
    for k in C.SKILL_ATTRS:
        if k in w:      # the more a role leans on an attribute, the better he is at it
            a[k] = t + rng.gauss(0.2 + 3.0 * (w[k] - 0.14), 1.3)
        else:
            a[k] = t - 3.2 + rng.gauss(0, 1.9)
    if pos != "RUCK":
        a["ruck"] = rng.gauss(8.0 if tall else 4.0, 1.5)
    # Kids are skilled but under-done physically; veterans lose their legs
    if age <= 21:
        a["strength"] -= 1.2; a["endurance"] -= 0.8; a["decision"] -= 0.8
    elif age >= 30:
        a["speed"] -= 1.2; a["decision"] += 0.8; a["endurance"] -= 0.4
    for _ in range(5):  # shift the role-relevant attributes until the rating lands on target
        for k in a:
            a[k] = _clamp(a[k], 1.0, 20.0)
        diff = t - raw_rating(a, pos)
        if abs(diff) < 0.01:
            break
        for k in w:
            a[k] += diff
    for k in a:
        a[k] = _clamp(a[k], 1.0, 20.0)
    a["leadership"] = _clamp(rng.gauss(6.0 + (age - 18) * 0.55, 2.6), 1, 20)
    a["consistency"] = _clamp(rng.gauss(11.0 + (age - 18) * 0.2, 2.6), 3, 20)
    a["injury_prone"] = _clamp(rng.gauss(8.0, 3.2), 1, 19)
    return a


def market_wage(ovr: float, age: int, pot: float | None = None, scale: float = 1.0) -> int:
    """What a player of this quality is worth per season, in $k."""
    w = 100 + 12 * max(0.0, ovr - 55) + 1.4 * max(0.0, ovr - 65) ** 2
    if pot is not None and age <= 23:
        w += max(0.0, pot - ovr) * 4          # paying for upside
    if age >= 31:
        w *= 0.85
    if age >= 33:
        w *= 0.85
    return int(round(max(C.MIN_WAGE, w * scale) / 5.0) * 5)


def _name(rng, used: set) -> tuple[str, str]:
    for _ in range(50):
        n = (rng.choice(FIRST_NAMES), rng.choice(LAST_NAMES))
        if n not in used:
            used.add(n)
            return n
    return n


def make_player(rng, game: Game, pos: str, age: int, pa: float, ca: float, used: set,
                club: str | None = None) -> Player:
    first, last = _name(rng, used)
    positions = [pos]
    for sec, prob in SECONDARY[pos]:
        if rng.random() < prob and sec not in positions:
            positions.append(sec)
            break
    lo, hi = HEIGHTS[pos]
    p = Player(
        id=game.new_player_id(), first=first, last=last, age=age,
        height=rng.randint(lo, hi), club=club, positions=positions,
        attrs=gen_attrs(rng, pos, ca, age), potential=pa,
        scout_noise=rng.gauss(0, 2.5), dev_rate=_clamp(rng.gauss(1.0, 0.18), 0.55, 1.45),
    )
    return p


def make_prospect(rng, game: Game, used: set) -> Player:
    """A draft hopeful: mostly 18-year-olds with a sprinkling of mature-agers."""
    pos = rng.choices(list(PROSPECT_POS_WEIGHTS), weights=list(PROSPECT_POS_WEIGHTS.values()))[0]
    if rng.random() < 0.85:
        age, pa = 18, _clamp(rng.gauss(70.5, 8.5), 56, 95)
    else:
        age, pa = rng.choice([19, 20, 21, 22]), _clamp(rng.gauss(68.0, 5.0), 58, 84)
    ca = _clamp(pa * curve(age) + rng.gauss(0, 2.5), 40, pa - 1)
    p = make_player(rng, game, pos, age, pa, ca, used)
    p.status = "prospect"
    p.scout_noise = rng.gauss(0, 5.5)          # nobody really knows with kids
    return p


def generate_draft_pool(game: Game, rng=None) -> None:
    rng = rng or random
    used = {(p.first, p.last) for p in game.players.values()}
    pool = []
    for _ in range(C.DRAFT_POOL_SIZE):
        p = make_prospect(rng, game, used)
        game.players[p.id] = p
        pool.append(p.id)
    game.draft["pool"] = pool
    game.draft["pool_year"] = game.year
    game.draft["live"] = None


def add_draft_picks(game: Game, year: int) -> None:
    for cid in game.clubs:
        for rnd in range(1, C.DRAFT_ROUNDS + 1):
            game.draft["picks"].append({"year": year, "round": rnd, "orig": cid, "owner": cid})


def _build_list(rng, game: Game, club: Club, strength: float, used: set) -> None:
    age_shift = rng.gauss(strength * 0.3, 0.5)
    ages = list(AGE_WEIGHTS)
    weights = [AGE_WEIGHTS[a] * (1.0 + 0.09 * age_shift * (a - 24)) for a in ages]
    weights = [max(0.05, w) for w in weights]
    for pos in LIST_TEMPLATE:
        age = rng.choices(ages, weights=weights)[0]
        pa = rng.gauss(73.5 + strength, 6.3)
        if age >= 24:                       # survivors: older players are there on merit
            pa += (min(age, 30) - 23) * 0.4
        pa = _clamp(pa, 58, 94)
        ca = pa * curve(age) + rng.gauss(0, 1.5)
        floor = 67 if age >= 29 else 64 if age >= 26 else 60 if age >= 23 else 0
        if ca < floor:
            ca = floor + rng.uniform(0, 4)
        if age >= 28:
            pa = ca + rng.uniform(0, 1)     # what you see is what you get
        else:
            pa = max(pa, ca + 1)
        p = make_player(rng, game, pos, age, _clamp(pa, 40, 97), ca, used, club=club.id)
        # a plausible back-story: games and goals before the career starts
        per_year = _clamp((ca - 56) * 0.95, 0, 21) * rng.uniform(0.55, 1.0)
        p.career["games"] = int(max(0, age - 18) * per_year)
        rate = {"KF": 1.6, "GF": 1.0, "MD": 0.45, "WG": 0.35, "RK": 0.3, "GD": 0.12, "KD": 0.04}[C.POS_GROUP[pos]]
        p.career["goals"] = int(p.career["games"] * rate * rng.uniform(0.7, 1.3))
        game.players[p.id] = p


def _set_contracts(rng, game: Game, club: Club) -> None:
    squad = game.squad(club.id)
    # the five rawest kids go on the rookie list
    kids = sorted((p for p in squad if p.age <= 23), key=overall)[:5]
    for p in squad:
        o = overall(p)
        if p in kids:
            p.rookie, p.wage = True, C.ROOKIE_WAGE
            p.contract_end = game.year + rng.choice([0, 1, 1])
            continue
        p.wage = market_wage(o, p.age, p.potential)
        years = rng.choices([0, 1, 2, 3, 4], weights=[28, 30, 22, 13, 7])[0]
        if o >= 80:
            years = min(5, years + 1)
        if p.age <= 19:
            years = max(1, years)
        if p.age >= 32:
            years = min(1, years)
        p.contract_end = game.year + years
    # Squeeze or stretch senior wages so the club sits somewhere under the cap.
    target = game.cap * rng.uniform(0.93, 0.995)
    seniors = [p for p in squad if not p.rookie]
    fixed = sum(p.wage for p in squad if p.rookie)
    k = (target - fixed) / max(1, sum(p.wage for p in seniors))
    for p in seniors:
        p.wage = int(round(max(C.MIN_WAGE, p.wage * k) / 5.0) * 5)
    return k


def new_game(seed: int | None = None, save_name: str = "career") -> Game:
    """Create a fresh world.  The user picks a club afterwards (see choose_club)."""
    from . import season, finance              # local imports avoid cycles

    if seed is None:
        seed = random.randrange(1, 10 ** 6)
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    g = Game()
    g.meta = {"version": C.SAVE_VERSION, "save_name": save_name, "seed": seed,
              "year": C.START_YEAR, "phase": "season", "round": 1, "user_club": None,
              "manager": "", "hired": C.START_YEAR, "selection": "auto", "cap": C.SALARY_CAP, "wage_scale": 1.0, "next_pid": 0,
              "next_mid": 0}
    g.draft = {"picks": [], "pool": [], "pool_year": C.START_YEAR, "live": None}

    tiers = STRENGTH_TIERS[:]
    rng.shuffle(tiers)
    philosophies = [n for n in C.PHILOSOPHIES]
    used, scales = set(), []
    for (cid, name, nick, ground, state, colours, sup), strength in zip(C.CLUBS, tiers):
        club = Club(id=cid, name=name, nickname=nick, ground=ground, state=state,
                    colours=colours, supporters=float(sup))
        club.balance = int(1500 + sup * 60 + rng.uniform(-800, 800))
        club.dev = round(_clamp(rng.gauss(1.0, 0.07), 0.85, 1.15), 2)
        club.recruit = round(_clamp(rng.gauss(1.0, 0.07), 0.85, 1.15), 2)
        club.philosophy = rng.choice(philosophies)
        club.tactics = dict(C.PHILOSOPHIES[club.philosophy])
        g.clubs[cid] = club
        _build_list(rng, g, club, strength, used)
        scales.append(_set_contracts(rng, g, club))
    g.meta["wage_scale"] = round(sum(scales) / len(scales), 3)

    ranking = sorted(g.clubs, key=lambda c: best22_rating(g, c), reverse=True)
    for i, cid in enumerate(ranking):
        club = g.clubs[cid]
        club.strategy = "contend" if i < 6 else "rebuild" if i >= 12 else "balanced"
        pick_captain(g, club)
    for year in (g.year, g.year + 1):
        add_draft_picks(g, year)
    generate_draft_pool(g, rng)
    season.start_season(g, rng)
    finance.set_board_expectations(g)
    from .ratings import auto_select
    for cid, club in g.clubs.items():
        club.lineup = auto_select(g, cid)
    g.add_news(f"Welcome to the {g.year} season. Eighteen clubs, one flag.", "league", "Pre-season")
    return g


def pick_captain(game: Game, club: Club) -> None:
    """Captain = best leader among the senior core."""
    core = sorted(game.squad(club.id), key=overall, reverse=True)[:26]
    if core:
        club.captain = max(core, key=lambda p: p.attrs["leadership"] + (p.age >= 24) * 1.0).id

"""The match engine.

``simulate_match`` is a pure function of the two selected sides, their game
plans, the venue and a random source.  It never mutates the Game: applying
the result (stats, fitness, injuries, ladder) is season.py's job, which keeps
the engine easy to test and to swap out later.

How a game is played
--------------------
A match is ~105 "passages" of play.  Every passage ends with one side going
inside 50, so the engine is really answering two footy questions over and over:

1. WHO GOES FORWARD?
   * From a centre bounce or stoppage: ruck contest -> clearance -> entry.
     Hit-outs come from the ruckman, clearances from the on-ball brigade.
   * In general play: a contest between the two sides' "territory" ratings
     (midfield, run and spread, ball use, rebound) shaped by style, pressure
     and fatigue, plus momentum from the previous passage (a rebound from an
     intercept mark is the best launching pad in the game).

2. WHAT HAPPENS INSIDE 50?
   * Long shot from outside the arc, or
   * a kick to a target: forward v his defender -> mark and set shot,
     intercept mark (rebound!), or a spoil that brings it to ground, or
   * ground ball: crumbers v small defenders -> snap, rushed behind or clearance.

Every one of those contests uses the attributes of the individual players
involved, scaled by fitness, form, familiarity with the role, home ground
advantage and a per-game "day" roll that depends on Consistency.

Disposals, marks and tackles that happen between the arcs are handed out in
bulk at the end, weighted by role and quality.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import math
import random

from . import constants as C
from .models import Game
from .ratings import raw_rating, familiarity, condition_mult

# ---- tuning knobs (see tests/calibrate.py) -----------------------------------
PASSAGES_PER_QTR = 26.4     # ~53 inside 50s a side
K_TERRITORY = 0.24          # how sharply territory rating gaps turn into entries
K_RUCK = 0.28
K_CLEAR = 0.22
BASE_REF = 14.5             # attribute level of a typical senior player in his role
REF_RATING = 15.0           # ...and the average role rating the knobs were tuned at

# Role weights for bulk stats
DISP_W = {"C": 1.75, "RR": 1.65, "ROV": 1.6, "W": 1.5, "HBF": 1.5, "RUCK": 1.05,
          "HFF": 1.2, "CHB": 1.1, "BP": 1.05, "FB": 0.9, "CHF": 1.0, "FP": 0.95, "FF": 0.75}
KICK_SHARE = {"C": .50, "RR": .43, "ROV": .50, "W": .62, "HBF": .66, "RUCK": .38,
              "HFF": .60, "CHB": .62, "BP": .60, "FB": .64, "CHF": .62, "FP": .58, "FF": .72}
MARK_W = {"C": .8, "RR": .6, "ROV": .7, "W": 1.3, "HBF": 1.4, "RUCK": .8, "HFF": 1.1,
          "CHB": 1.5, "BP": 1.0, "FB": 1.1, "CHF": 1.2, "FP": .7, "FF": .9}
TACKLE_W = {"C": 1.5, "RR": 1.7, "ROV": 1.4, "W": .8, "HBF": .8, "RUCK": .7, "HFF": .9,
            "CHB": .5, "BP": .9, "FB": .5, "CHF": .6, "FP": 1.2, "FF": .5}
DELIVER_W = {"C": 2.0, "RR": 1.5, "ROV": 1.8, "W": 2.0, "HBF": 1.2, "HFF": 1.5, "RUCK": .5,
             "CHF": .7, "CHB": .3, "BP": .2, "FB": .1, "FP": .4, "FF": .1}
TARGET_W = {"FF": 3.2, "CHF": 2.4, "HFL": 0.9, "HFR": 0.9, "FPL": 0.8, "FPR": 0.8, "RUCK": 0.5}
CRUMB_W = {"FPL": 2.0, "FPR": 2.0, "HFL": 1.3, "HFR": 1.3, "ROV": 1.5, "C": 1.3, "RR": 1.1,
           "WL": 0.9, "WR": 0.9, "FF": 0.8, "CHF": 0.8, "HBL": 0.3, "HBR": 0.3}
LONG_W = {"C": 2.0, "RR": 1.6, "ROV": 1.8, "WL": 1.8, "WR": 1.8, "HFL": 1.4, "HFR": 1.4,
          "HBL": 1.0, "HBR": 1.0, "CHF": 0.6, "FPL": 0.4, "FPR": 0.4, "RUCK": 0.3}
# Expected "impact score" for an average player in each role over a full game.
# Measured with tests/calibrate.py; used to turn raw output into a 1-10 rating.
EXPECTED = {"C": 127, "RR": 113, "ROV": 111, "W": 100, "HBF": 97, "RUCK": 103, "HFF": 95,
            "CHB": 77, "BP": 60, "FB": 68, "CHF": 86, "FP": 70, "FF": 71}
# ...and how much that score typically varies game to game (one standard deviation),
# so a key forward's bag and a midfielder's 38 touches are judged on the same scale.
SPREAD = {"C": 27, "RR": 25, "ROV": 25, "W": 22, "HBF": 21, "RUCK": 26, "HFF": 25,
          "CHB": 18, "BP": 16, "FB": 18, "CHF": 27, "FP": 21, "FF": 26}
BENCH_EXPECTED = 0.44       # interchange players see less of it
TOG_FIELD, TOG_BENCH = 0.88, 0.55


def _sig(x: float) -> float:
    return 1.0 / (1.0 + math.exp(-x))


def _clamp(x, lo, hi):
    return lo if x < lo else hi if x > hi else x


class PlayerDay:
    """One player's afternoon: his match-day multiplier and stat line."""
    __slots__ = ("p", "slot", "pt", "tog", "m", "rating", "st", "conceded")

    def __init__(self, p, slot, rng, team_mult):
        self.p, self.slot = p, slot
        bench = slot not in C.FIELD_SLOTS
        self.pt = p.pos if bench else C.FIELD_SLOTS[slot]
        self.tog = TOG_BENCH if bench else TOG_FIELD
        sigma = 0.085 - 0.0035 * p.attrs["consistency"]          # steady players vary less
        day = _clamp(1.0 + rng.gauss(0, sigma), 0.82, 1.18)
        self.m = condition_mult(p) * day * team_mult * familiarity(p, self.pt)
        self.rating = raw_rating(p.attrs, self.pt) * self.m
        self.st = {"k": 0, "hb": 0, "m": 0, "t": 0, "g": 0, "b": 0, "ho": 0,
                   "cl": 0, "i50": 0, "int": 0, "sp": 0}
        self.conceded = 0

    def a(self, attr: str) -> float:
        return self.p.attrs[attr] * self.m

    def mix(self, weights: dict) -> float:
        return sum(self.p.attrs[k] * w for k, w in weights.items()) * self.m


class Side:
    """A selected 23 with its game plan and the team ratings derived from it."""

    def __init__(self, game: Game, club_id: str, team_mult: float, rng, wet: bool, REF: float = BASE_REF):
        club = game.clubs[club_id]
        self.cid, self.name, self.tac, self.rng = club_id, club.name, club.tactics, rng
        leaders = sorted((game.players[pid].attrs["leadership"] for pid in club.lineup.values()),
                         reverse=True)[:3]
        cap = game.players.get(club.captain)
        if cap and cap.id in club.lineup.values():
            leaders.append(cap.attrs["leadership"])               # the skipper counts twice
        team_mult *= 1.0 + (sum(leaders) / len(leaders) - 13.0) * 0.002
        self.e = {slot: PlayerDay(game.players[pid], slot, rng, team_mult)
                  for slot, pid in club.lineup.items()}
        self.field = [self.e[s] for s in C.FIELD_SLOTS]
        self.bench = [self.e[s] for s in C.BENCH_SLOTS if s in self.e]
        self.everyone = self.field + self.bench
        e = self.e

        def grp(slots, w):
            return sum(e[s].mix(w) for s in slots) / len(slots)

        def line(code):
            xs = [d.rating for d in self.field if C.LINE_OF[d.pt] == code]
            return sum(xs) / len(xs)

        self.ruck = e["RUCK"].mix({"ruck": .7, "strength": .2, "marking": .1})
        self.clr = grp(["C", "RR", "ROV"], {"toughness": .28, "handballing": .24, "strength": .18,
                                             "decision": .16, "tackling": .14})
        self.spread = grp(["WL", "WR", "HBL", "HBR", "C", "ROV"],
                          {"endurance": .3, "speed": .25, "kicking": .25, "decision": .2})
        n = len(self.field)
        self.skill = sum(d.mix({"kicking": .6, "decision": .4}) for d in self.field) / n
        self.press = sum(d.mix({"tackling": .45, "endurance": .3, "toughness": .25}) for d in self.field) / n
        self.stam = sum(d.a("endurance") for d in self.field) / n
        self.mid_r, self.def_r, self.fwd_r = line("M"), line("D"), line("F")
        backs = ["BPL", "FB", "BPR", "HBL", "CHB", "HBR"]
        self.zoneq = grp(backs, {"intercept": .5, "decision": .5})
        self.def_air = grp(backs, {"intercept": .5, "strength": .25, "marking": .25})
        self.fground = grp(["FPL", "FPR", "HFL", "HFR", "ROV"], {"speed": .35, "goal_sense": .35, "tackling": .3})
        self.dground = grp(["BPL", "BPR", "HBL", "HBR"], {"speed": .35, "intercept": .35, "tackling": .3})
        self.depth = (sum(d.rating for d in self.bench) / len(self.bench)) if self.bench else 11.0

        t = self.tac
        # How quickly the side tires: manic pressure and all-out run cost legs.
        load = 1.0 + {"low": -.3, "medium": 0, "high": .5}[t["pressure"]] \
                   + {"slow": -.15, "balanced": 0, "fast": .25}[t["tempo"]]
        self.fade = load * max(0.3, 16.5 - self.stam) * 0.028 - 0.02 * (self.depth - REF)
        self.fade = max(0.0, self.fade)

        # Territory: the general-play arm wrestle.
        terr = (0.38 * self.mid_r + 0.22 * self.spread + 0.14 * self.skill
                + 0.14 * self.def_r + 0.12 * self.fwd_r)
        if t["style"] == "outside":
            terr += 0.07 * (self.skill - REF) + (-0.15 if wet else 0.0)
        elif t["style"] == "contested":
            terr += 0.03 * (self.clr - REF) + (0.15 if wet else 0.0)
        if t["pressure"] == "high":
            terr += 0.20 + 0.06 * (self.press - REF)
        elif t["pressure"] == "low":
            terr -= 0.20
        if t["defence"] == "loose":
            terr -= 0.20
        terr += 0.08 * (self.depth - REF)
        self.terr = terr
        self.clr_eff = self.clr * {"contested": 1.04, "balanced": 1.0, "outside": 0.97}[t["style"]] \
            + (0.2 if wet and t["style"] == "contested" else 0.0)

        # Pre-computed weighted pickers
        self._deliver = self._weights(self.field, lambda d: DELIVER_W[d.pt] * (d.mix({"kicking": .5, "endurance": .5}) / REF) ** 1.2)
        tallf = {"tall": 1.25, "balanced": 1.0, "small": 0.75}[t["forward"]]
        tw = []
        for s, w in TARGET_W.items():
            d = e[s]
            if s in ("FF", "CHF"):
                w *= tallf
            tw.append(w * (d.a("marking") / REF) ** 0.8)
        self._targets = ([e[s] for s in TARGET_W], self._cum(tw))
        self._crumb = ([e[s] for s in CRUMB_W],
                       self._cum([w * e[s].a("goal_sense") / REF for s, w in CRUMB_W.items()]))
        self._long = ([e[s] for s in LONG_W],
                      self._cum([w * e[s].a("kicking") / REF for s, w in LONG_W.items()]))
        # Clearances: the on-ball trio lead, but everyone at the coalface gets a few.
        clr_w = {"C": 2.2, "RR": 2.4, "ROV": 2.0, "RUCK": 1.2, "W": 0.9, "HFF": 0.7, "HBF": 0.6, "CHF": 0.3}
        self._mids = self._weights(
            [d for d in self.everyone if d.pt in clr_w],
            lambda d: clr_w[d.pt] * (0.55 if d in self.bench else 1.0)
            * (d.mix({"toughness": .4, "handballing": .3, "strength": .3}) / REF) ** 2)
        self._backs = [e[s] for s in backs]

    @staticmethod
    def _cum(ws):
        out, tot = [], 0.0
        for w in ws:
            tot += w
            out.append(tot)
        return out

    def _weights(self, pop, fn):
        return (pop, self._cum([fn(d) for d in pop]))

    def pick(self, table):
        return self.rng.choices(table[0], cum_weights=table[1])[0]


def home_advantage(game: Game, home_id: str, away_id: str, venue: str) -> tuple[float, float]:
    """Match-day multipliers (home, away).  Interstate trips hurt the most."""
    h, a = game.clubs[home_id], game.clubs[away_id]
    vstate = C.VENUES[venue][0]
    hm = am = 1.0
    if h.state == vstate and a.state != vstate:
        hm, am = 1.012, 0.988                     # the long flight
    elif a.state == vstate and h.state != vstate:
        hm, am = 0.988, 1.012                     # e.g. a Grand Final at the MCG
    elif h.ground == venue and a.ground != venue:
        hm = 1.012 if venue == "GMHBA Stadium" else 1.007
    elif a.ground == venue and h.ground != venue:
        am = 1.007
    else:
        hm = 1.003                                # shared ground: just the crowd split
    return hm, am


def simulate_match(game: Game, home_id: str, away_id: str, venue: str, *,
                   is_final: bool = False, rng=None, wet: bool | None = None) -> dict:
    rng = rng or random
    if wet is None:
        wet = rng.random() < C.VENUES[venue][3]
    hm, am = home_advantage(game, home_id, away_id, venue)
    # Skill-dependent odds (accuracy, entry quality...) are measured against the
    # standard of the two sides on the day, so scoring stays realistic even if
    # the whole league gets better or worse over a long career.
    levels = [raw_rating(game.players[pid].attrs, pt)
              for cid in (home_id, away_id)
              for slot, pt in C.FIELD_SLOTS.items()
              if (pid := game.clubs[cid].lineup.get(slot)) in game.players]
    REF = BASE_REF + 0.7 * (sum(levels) / len(levels) - REF_RATING)
    sides = (Side(game, home_id, hm, rng, wet, REF), Side(game, away_id, am, rng, wet, REF))
    score = [[0, 0], [0, 0]]                      # [goals, behinds] per side
    timeline = []                                 # every score: [quarter, minute, side, G|B|R, player id]
    tstat = [{"i50": 0, "cl": 0, "ho": 0}, {"i50": 0, "cl": 0, "ho": 0}]
    events, quarters = [], []

    def pts(i):
        return score[i][0] * 6 + score[i][1]

    tempo = sum({"slow": -0.04, "balanced": 0, "fast": 0.04}[s.tac["tempo"]] for s in sides)
    base_n = PASSAGES_PER_QTR * (1 + tempo) * (0.95 if wet else 1.0)

    def stoppage(q, count_extra=True):
        """Ruck contest then clearance.  Returns the index of the side that wins it."""
        A, B = sides
        ho = 0 if rng.random() < _sig(K_RUCK * (A.ruck - B.ruck)) else 1
        if rng.random() < 0.9:
            sides[ho].e["RUCK"].st["ho"] += 1
            tstat[ho]["ho"] += 1
        if count_extra and rng.random() < 0.25:   # repeat ball-up
            ho2 = 0 if rng.random() < _sig(K_RUCK * (A.ruck - B.ruck)) else 1
            sides[ho2].e["RUCK"].st["ho"] += 1
            tstat[ho2]["ho"] += 1
        edge = K_CLEAR * ((A.clr_eff - A.fade * (q - 1)) - (B.clr_eff - B.fade * (q - 1)))
        edge += 0.22 if ho == 0 else -0.22
        w = 0 if rng.random() < _sig(edge) else 1
        sides[w].pick(sides[w]._mids).st["cl"] += 1
        tstat[w]["cl"] += 1
        return w

    def shot(i, shooter, kind, q, minute, base, wet_pen):
        """Resolve a scoring shot.  Returns 'goal' | 'behind' | 'miss'."""
        skill = 0.65 * shooter.a("goal_sense") + 0.35 * shooter.a("kicking")
        p_goal = _clamp(base + 0.015 * (skill - REF) - (wet_pen if wet else 0), 0.2, 0.85)
        shooter.st["k"] += 1
        r = rng.random()
        if r < p_goal:
            lead_before = pts(i) - pts(1 - i)
            shooter.st["g"] += 1
            score[i][0] += 1
            timeline.append([q, minute, i, "G", shooter.p.id])
            events.append((q, minute, "goal", i, shooter, kind, lead_before))
            return "goal"
        if r < p_goal + (1 - p_goal) * (0.70 if kind == "set" else 0.62):
            shooter.st["b"] += 1
            score[i][1] += 1
            timeline.append([q, minute, i, "B", shooter.p.id])
            return "behind"
        return "miss"

    def entry(i, q, minute):
        """Side i goes inside 50.  Returns (next_state, advantage_side, advantage_size)."""
        att, dfn = sides[i], sides[1 - i]
        tstat[i]["i50"] += 1
        kicker = att.pick(att._deliver)
        kicker.st["i50"] += 1
        kicker.st["k"] += 1
        at, dt = att.tac, dfn.tac
        eq = (kicker.mix({"kicking": .6, "decision": .4}) - REF) / 10.0
        eq -= {"low": -0.03, "medium": 0.0, "high": 0.035}[dt["pressure"]] + (dfn.press - REF) * 0.008
        eq += {"outside": 0.03, "balanced": 0.0, "contested": -0.02}[at["style"]]
        fast, slow = at["tempo"] == "fast", at["tempo"] == "slow"
        reb = 0.45 * (1.45 if fast else 0.75 if slow else 1.0) * (0.85 if at["forward"] == "small" else 1.0)
        loose_cost = at["defence"] == "loose"      # attacking side is a forward short

        # -- long shot from outside 50 / running goal --------------------------
        if rng.random() < (0.125 if fast else 0.10):
            res = shot(i, att.pick(att._long), "long", q, minute, 0.36, 0.06)
            if res == "goal":
                return "bounce", None, 0
            return "open", 1 - i, 0.12 if res == "behind" else 0.2

        target_p = 0.60 + {"tall": .10, "balanced": 0, "small": -.10}[at["forward"]] + 0.25 * eq
        target_p -= (0.10 if wet else 0) + (0.05 if at["style"] == "contested" else 0)
        ground = True
        if rng.random() < target_p:
            fwd = att.pick(att._targets)
            if fwd.slot in C.MATCHUP and rng.random() < (0.8 if dt["defence"] == "man" else 0.5):
                opp = dfn.e[C.MATCHUP[fwd.slot]]
            else:
                opp = rng.choice(dfn._backs)
            tall = fwd.pt in ("FF", "CHF", "RUCK")
            if tall:
                fs = fwd.mix({"marking": .5, "strength": .3, "speed": .2})
                ds = opp.mix({"intercept": .5, "strength": .3, "marking": .2})
            else:
                fs = fwd.mix({"marking": .5, "speed": .35, "strength": .15})
                ds = opp.mix({"intercept": .5, "speed": .35, "strength": .15})
            if dt["defence"] != "man":
                ds = 0.5 * ds + 0.5 * dfn.def_air           # team defence shares the load
            diff = fs - ds
            p_mark = 0.30 + 0.022 * diff + 0.20 * eq
            p_int = 0.19 - 0.018 * diff - 0.14 * eq
            if dt["defence"] == "loose":
                p_mark -= 0.05
                p_int += 0.04
            elif dt["defence"] == "zone":
                z = _clamp(dfn.zoneq - att.skill, -3, 3)     # good users slice a zone
                p_mark -= 0.01 + 0.014 * z - (0.02 if fast else 0)
                p_int += 0.02 + 0.016 * z
            if fast:
                p_mark += 0.02
            elif slow:
                p_mark -= 0.01
            if loose_cost:
                p_mark -= 0.03
            if wet:
                p_mark -= 0.07
                p_int -= 0.05
            p_mark, p_int = _clamp(p_mark, 0.06, 0.62), _clamp(p_int, 0.04, 0.45)
            r = rng.random()
            if r < p_mark:
                fwd.st["m"] += 1
                if p_mark < 0.24 and tall and rng.random() < 0.5:
                    events.append((q, minute, "screamer", i, fwd, opp, 0))
                res = shot(i, fwd, "set", q, minute, 0.61, 0.05)
                if res == "goal":
                    opp.conceded += 1
                    return "bounce", None, 0
                return "open", 1 - i, 0.12 if res == "behind" else 0.2
            if r < p_mark + p_int:
                opp.st["m"] += 1
                opp.st["int"] += 1
                return "open", 1 - i, reb
            opp.st["sp"] += 1                                # spoiled: ball hits the deck

        if ground:
            p_fwd = 0.36 + 0.025 * (att.fground - dfn.dground)
            p_fwd += {"tall": -.04, "balanced": 0, "small": .05}[at["forward"]]
            p_fwd += (-0.05 if dt["defence"] == "loose" else 0) + (-0.04 if loose_cost else 0)
            p_fwd += (0.02 if wet else 0) + (0.02 if at["style"] == "contested" else 0)
            if rng.random() < _clamp(p_fwd, 0.15, 0.70):
                res = shot(i, att.pick(att._crumb), "snap", q, minute, 0.41 + (0.02 if fast else 0), 0.03)
                if res == "goal":
                    return "bounce", None, 0
                if res == "behind":
                    return "open", 1 - i, 0.12
                return "stoppage", None, 0
            if rng.random() < 0.3:
                rng.choice(dfn._backs).st["t"] += 1
            r = rng.random()
            if r < 0.08:                                     # rushed through
                score[i][1] += 1
                timeline.append([q, minute, i, "R", 0])
                return "open", 1 - i, 0.12
            if r < 0.55:
                return "open", 1 - i, reb * 0.55
            return "stoppage", None, 0
        return "open", None, 0

    def play(q, n):
        state, adv, adv_size = "bounce", None, 0.0
        for k in range(n):
            minute = int(k / n * 30) + 1
            if state == "open" and rng.random() < 0.22:
                state = "stoppage"
            if state in ("bounce", "stoppage"):
                w = stoppage(q)
                A = sides[w]
                keep = 0.64 + 0.01 * (A.skill - sides[1 - w].press)
                i = w if rng.random() < _clamp(keep, 0.5, 0.78) else 1 - w
            else:
                A, B = sides
                edge = K_TERRITORY * ((A.terr - A.fade * (q - 1)) - (B.terr - B.fade * (q - 1)))
                if adv is not None:
                    edge += adv_size if adv == 0 else -adv_size
                i = 0 if rng.random() < _sig(edge) else 1
                if rng.random() < 0.25:                      # an around-the-ground stoppage on the way
                    stoppage(q, count_extra=False)
            state, adv, adv_size = entry(i, q, minute)

    for q in (1, 2, 3, 4):
        play(q, max(18, int(round(rng.gauss(base_n, 1.8)))))
        quarters.append([score[0][0], score[0][1], score[1][0], score[1][1]])
    extra_time = False
    while is_final and pts(0) == pts(1):                     # finals can't be drawn
        extra_time = True
        play(5, 6)
        quarters.append([score[0][0], score[0][1], score[1][0], score[1][1]])

    # -- between-the-arcs stats ------------------------------------------------
    tot_i50 = tstat[0]["i50"] + tstat[1]["i50"]
    for i, s in enumerate(sides):
        share = tstat[i]["i50"] / max(1, tot_i50)
        t = s.tac
        f_disp = {"slow": 1.06, "balanced": 1.0, "fast": 0.97}[t["tempo"]] * \
                 {"outside": 1.03, "balanced": 1.0, "contested": 0.97}[t["style"]]
        n_disp = int(rng.gauss(295, 16) * f_disp * (0.86 + 0.28 * share) * (0.94 if wet else 1))
        w = [DISP_W[d.pt] * d.tog * (d.rating / REF) ** 0.9 for d in s.everyone]
        hb_bias = 0.04 if t["style"] == "contested" else -0.02 if t["style"] == "outside" else 0
        for d in rng.choices(s.everyone, weights=w, k=n_disp):
            if rng.random() < KICK_SHARE[d.pt] - hb_bias - (0.03 if wet else 0):
                d.st["k"] += 1
            else:
                d.st["hb"] += 1
        f_mark = {"slow": 1.10, "balanced": 1.0, "fast": 0.95}[t["tempo"]] * \
                 {"outside": 1.06, "balanced": 1.0, "contested": 0.92}[t["style"]]
        n_mark = int(rng.gauss(76, 8) * f_mark * (0.75 if wet else 1))
        w = [MARK_W[d.pt] * d.tog * (d.a("marking") / REF) ** 1.5 for d in s.everyone]
        for d in rng.choices(s.everyone, weights=w, k=n_mark):
            d.st["m"] += 1
        f_tack = {"low": 0.9, "medium": 1.0, "high": 1.12}[t["pressure"]] * (1.15 if wet else 1)
        n_tack = int(rng.gauss(51, 6) * f_tack * (1.14 - 0.28 * share))
        w = [TACKLE_W[d.pt] * d.tog * (d.a("tackling") / REF) ** 1.8 for d in s.everyone]
        for d in rng.choices(s.everyone, weights=w, k=n_tack):
            d.st["t"] += 1

    # -- player ratings and votes ----------------------------------------------
    margin = pts(0) - pts(1)
    players, ranked = {}, []
    for i, s in enumerate(sides):
        won = (margin > 0) if i == 0 else (margin < 0)
        for d in s.everyone:
            st = d.st
            impact = (3 * st["k"] + 2 * st["hb"] + 3 * st["m"] + 4 * st["t"] + 6 * st["g"] + st["b"]
                      + st["ho"] + 2 * st["cl"] + 3 * st["int"] + 2.5 * st["sp"] + st["i50"]
                      - 3 * d.conceded)
            on = d.slot in C.FIELD_SLOTS
            exp = EXPECTED[d.pt] * (1.0 if on else BENCH_EXPECTED)
            sd = SPREAD[d.pt] * (1.0 if on else 0.6)
            rating = _clamp(6.0 + 1.15 * (impact - exp) / sd + (0.2 if won else 0), 1.0, 10.0)
            players[d.p.id] = {"side": i, "slot": d.slot, **st, "rt": round(rating, 1)}
            # Brownlow votes: umpires notice ball-winners and winners
            eye = {"MD": 0.6, "WG": 0.2, "RK": 0.2, "GD": 0.1, "KD": -0.3}.get(C.POS_GROUP[d.pt], 0.0)
            ranked.append((rating + impact / 85.0 + eye + (0.3 if won else 0), d.p.id))
    ranked.sort(reverse=True)

    comm, feed = _commentary(sides, events, quarters, extra_time, wet)
    return {
        "home": home_id, "away": away_id, "venue": venue, "wet": wet, "final": is_final,
        "hs": [score[0][0], score[0][1], pts(0)], "as": [score[1][0], score[1][1], pts(1)],
        "qs": quarters, "et": extra_time,
        "team": tstat, "players": players, "votes": [pid for _, pid in ranked[:3]],
        "comm": comm, "feed": feed, "timeline": timeline,
        "tactics": [dict(sides[0].tac), dict(sides[1].tac)],
    }


def score_str(g: int, b: int) -> str:
    return f"{g}.{b} ({g * 6 + b})"


def _commentary(sides, events, quarters, extra_time, wet) -> tuple[list[str], list]:
    """Turn the event log into a short highlights reel.  Returns the text reel
    (for reports) and the same moments as [quarter, minute, text] (for live views)."""
    names = [s.name for s in sides]
    out, feed = [], []
    if wet:
        out.append("Conditions: wet and slippery - a day for the in-and-under types.")
    goals_by, streak_side, streak, shown_streak = {}, None, 0, False
    first, screamers = True, 0
    last_q = quarters and len(quarters)
    qlabel = {1: "QT", 2: "HT", 3: "3QT"}
    cur_q = 1

    def qline(q):
        hg, hb, ag, ab = quarters[q - 1]
        return f"{qlabel[q]}: {names[0]} {score_str(hg, hb)} - {names[1]} {score_str(ag, ab)}"

    def say(q, minute, tag, text):
        out.append(f"{tag}  {text}")
        feed.append([q, minute, text])

    for q, minute, kind, i, pl, extra, lead_before in events:
        while cur_q < q and cur_q <= 3:
            out.append(qline(cur_q))
            cur_q += 1
        tag = f"Q{q} {minute:>2}'" if q <= 4 else "ET"
        if kind == "screamer":
            if screamers < 2:
                screamers += 1
                say(q, minute, tag, f"SCREAMER! {pl.p.name} climbs over {extra.p.name} and pulls it down.")
            continue
        n = goals_by[pl.p.id] = goals_by.get(pl.p.id, 0) + 1
        if streak_side == i:
            streak += 1
        else:
            streak_side, streak, shown_streak = i, 1, False
        how = {"set": "goes back and slots the set shot", "snap": "snaps truly from the pocket",
               "long": "launches from outside 50 - it's home"}[extra]
        if first:
            say(q, minute, tag, f"{pl.p.name} {how} for the first of the day ({names[i]}).")
            first = False
        elif n in (4, 6, 8) or n == 5:
            word = {4: "fourth", 5: "FIFTH", 6: "sixth", 8: "eighth"}[n]
            say(q, minute, tag, f"{pl.p.name} has his {word}! He's having a day out for {names[i]}.")
        elif streak >= 4 and not shown_streak:
            shown_streak = True
            say(q, minute, tag, f"{names[i]} have kicked {streak} on the trot - {pl.p.name} with the latest.")
        elif q >= 4 and lead_before <= 0 and lead_before + 6 > 0:
            say(q, minute, tag, f"{pl.p.name} {how} and {names[i]} hit the front!")
        elif q >= 4 and minute >= 24 and 0 < lead_before <= 11:
            say(q, minute, tag, f"{pl.p.name} {how} - that might be the sealer for {names[i]}.")
    while cur_q <= 3:
        out.append(qline(cur_q))
        cur_q += 1
    hg, hb, ag, ab = quarters[-1]
    if extra_time:
        out.append("Scores level at the final siren - we go to extra time!")
    out.append(f"FT: {names[0]} {score_str(hg, hb)} - {names[1]} {score_str(ag, ab)}")
    # keep the reel tight: always keep quarter lines and the last few moments
    if len(out) > 16:
        keep = [l for l in out if l[:2] in ("QT", "HT", "3Q", "FT", "Co", "Sc")]
        other = [l for l in out if l not in keep]
        chosen = set(other[:3] + other[-(13 - len(keep)):]) if len(keep) < 13 else set(other[:3])
        out = [l for l in out if l in keep or l in chosen]
    return out, feed

"""Save / load a career as a folder of JSON files.

    saves/<name>/meta.json      year, phase, round, user club, cap ...
    saves/<name>/clubs.json     18 clubs (tactics, lineup, board, finances)
    saves/<name>/players.json   every player, one per line (diff friendly)
    saves/<name>/season.json    this year's fixture and results
    saves/<name>/draft.json     pick ownership, prospect pool, live draft state
    saves/<name>/history.json   past seasons, free agents and the news feed

JSON was chosen over SQLite so saves are human readable, easy to hand-edit
and merge nicely in git.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

from .models import Game, Player, Club
from . import constants as C

SAVE_ROOT = Path(os.environ.get("AFLM_SAVES", Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "saves"))
POINTER = "current.txt"     # remembers which save the CLI is working on


def save_dir(name: str) -> Path:
    return SAVE_ROOT / name


def _write(path: Path, obj, one_per_line: bool = False) -> None:
    tmp = path.with_suffix(".tmp")
    with open(tmp, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        if one_per_line:
            f.write("[\n" + ",\n".join(json.dumps(o, separators=(",", ":")) for o in obj) + "\n]\n")
        else:
            json.dump(obj, f, indent=1)
    tmp.replace(path)       # atomic: a crash never leaves a half-written file


def to_bundle(game: Game) -> dict:
    """The whole career as one JSON-ready object (same sections as the save folder)."""
    game.meta["version"] = C.SAVE_VERSION
    return {"meta": game.meta, "clubs": [c.to_dict() for c in game.clubs.values()],
            "players": [p.to_dict() for p in game.players.values()], "season": game.season,
            "draft": game.draft,
            "history": {"history": game.history, "free_agents": game.free_agents, "news": game.news}}


def from_bundle(b: dict) -> Game:
    g = Game()
    g.meta = b["meta"]
    g.clubs = {c["id"]: Club.from_dict(c) for c in b["clubs"]}
    g.players = {p["id"]: Player.from_dict(p) for p in b["players"]}
    g.season, g.draft = b["season"], b["draft"]
    h = b["history"]
    g.history, g.free_agents, g.news = h["history"], h["free_agents"], h["news"]
    return g


def save_game(game: Game, name: str | None = None) -> Path:
    name = name or game.meta.get("save_name", "career")
    game.meta["save_name"] = name
    b = to_bundle(game)
    d = save_dir(name)
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for section in ("meta", "clubs", "season", "draft", "history"):
        _write(d / f"{section}.json", b[section])
    _write(d / "players.json", b["players"], one_per_line=True)
    (SAVE_ROOT / POINTER).write_text(name)
    return d


def load_game(name: str | None = None) -> Game:
    name = name or current_save()
    if not name:
        raise FileNotFoundError("No save found. Start one with: python play.py new")
    d = save_dir(name)
    if not (d / "meta.json").exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"No save called '{name}' in {SAVE_ROOT}")

    def read(fn):
        with open(d / fn, encoding="utf-8") as f:
            return json.load(f)

    return from_bundle({s: read(f"{s}.json") for s in
                        ("meta", "clubs", "players", "season", "draft", "history")})


def current_save() -> str | None:
    p = SAVE_ROOT / POINTER
    if p.exists():
        name = p.read_text().strip()
        if (save_dir(name) / "meta.json").exists():
            return name
    saves = list_saves()
    return saves[0] if saves else None


def list_saves() -> list[str]:
    if not SAVE_ROOT.exists():
        return []
    return sorted(p.name for p in SAVE_ROOT.iterdir() if (p / "meta.json").exists())

"""Read-only "view models": plain rows of data for the UIs to display.

Both front ends (the text commands and the Streamlit app) build their tables
from these functions, so they always agree with each other.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from . import constants as C
from . import finance, offseason, season
from .models import Game, Player
from .ratings import ovr, overall, shown_potential, form_value, best22_rating, line_ratings


def money(k: float) -> str:
    """$k -> '$1.25M' / '$450k'."""
    return f"${k / 1000:.2f}M" if abs(k) >= 1000 else f"${int(k)}k"


def record(game: Game, cid: str) -> dict:
    return next(r for r in season.ladder(game) if r["club"] == cid)


def slot_of(game: Game, p: Player) -> str:
    if not p.club:
        return ""
    return next((s for s, pid in game.clubs[p.club].lineup.items() if pid == p.id), "")


def status_text(p: Player) -> str:
    if p.injury:
        return f"INJ {p.injury['type']} ({p.injury['weeks']}w)"
    return "Rookie" if p.rookie else ""


def player_row(game: Game, p: Player) -> dict:
    s = p.stats.get(str(game.year), {})
    gm = s.get("gm", 0)
    form = f"{form_value(p):.1f}" if p.form else (f"r{p.reserves:.1f}" if p.reserves else "-")
    return {
        "ID": p.id, "Name": p.name, "Pos": "/".join(p.positions), "Age": p.age, "Ht": p.height,
        "OVR": ovr(p), "POT": shown_potential(game, p), "Fit": int(round(p.fitness)), "Form": form,
        "Sel": slot_of(game, p), "Status": status_text(p), "Gm": gm, "Gls": s.get("g", 0),
        "Disp": round((s.get("k", 0) + s.get("hb", 0)) / gm, 1) if gm else 0.0,
        "Rtg": round(s.get("rt", 0) / gm, 2) if gm else 0.0,
        "Wage": p.wage, "Until": p.contract_end,
        "Value": int(round(offseason.player_value(game, p))),
    }


SQUAD_SORTS = {
    "pos": lambda r: (list(C.POS_GROUP.values()).index(C.POS_GROUP[r["Pos"].split("/")[0]]), -r["OVR"]),
    "ovr": lambda r: -r["OVR"], "pot": lambda r: -r["POT"], "age": lambda r: r["Age"],
    # senior form first, then players judged on reserves form, then the unsighted
    "form": lambda r: (r["Form"] == "-" or r["Form"].startswith("r") * 0.5,
                       -(float(r["Form"].lstrip("r")) if r["Form"] != "-" else 0)),
    "fit": lambda r: r["Fit"], "wage": lambda r: -r["Wage"], "value": lambda r: -r["Value"],
    "contract": lambda r: (r["Until"], -r["OVR"]), "goals": lambda r: -r["Gls"],
    "disp": lambda r: -r["Disp"], "rating": lambda r: -r["Rtg"], "name": lambda r: r["Name"].split()[-1],
}


def squad_rows(game: Game, cid: str, sort: str = "pos") -> list[dict]:
    rows = [player_row(game, p) for p in game.squad(cid)]
    rows.sort(key=SQUAD_SORTS.get(sort, SQUAD_SORTS["pos"]))
    return rows


def grade(x: float) -> str:
    """Club program quality (0.85-1.15) as a school report."""
    return "A" if x >= 1.08 else "B" if x >= 1.03 else "C" if x >= 0.97 else "D" if x >= 0.92 else "E"


def club_rows(game: Game) -> list[dict]:
    """The club-selection table: who is strong, who is old, who has cap room."""
    ranking = sorted(game.clubs, key=lambda c: best22_rating(game, c), reverse=True)
    rows = []
    for i, cid in enumerate(ranking):
        club, squad = game.clubs[cid], game.squad(cid)
        kids = sorted((p for p in squad if p.age <= 21), key=lambda p: p.potential, reverse=True)[:5]
        rows.append({
            "Rank": i + 1, "ID": cid, "Club": club.full_name, "Best 22": round(best22_rating(game, cid), 1),
            "Avg age": round(sum(p.age for p in squad) / len(squad), 1),
            "Young talent": round(sum(p.potential for p in kids) / max(1, len(kids)), 1),
            "Stars (85+)": sum(1 for p in squad if overall(p) >= 85),
            "Cap room": game.cap - game.payroll(cid), "Bank": club.balance,
            "Members (k)": club.supporters, "Dev": grade(club.dev), "Scout": grade(club.recruit),
            "Game plan": club.philosophy,
            "Board expects": club.board["label"],
        })
    return rows


def ladder_rows(game: Game) -> list[dict]:
    return [{"Pos": r["pos"], "Club": game.clubs[r["club"]].name, "ID": r["club"], "P": r["P"],
             "W": r["W"], "L": r["L"], "D": r["D"], "PF": r["PF"], "PA": r["PA"],
             "%": round(r["pct"], 1), "Pts": r["pts"]} for r in season.ladder(game)]


def result_text(game: Game, m: dict, perspective: str | None = None) -> str:
    h, a = game.clubs[m["home"]].name, game.clubs[m["away"]].name
    if not m["played"]:
        return f"{h} v {a} ({m['venue']})"
    hs, as_ = m["hs"], m["as"]
    return (f"{h} {hs[0]}.{hs[1]} ({hs[2]}) {'def' if hs[2] > as_[2] else 'drew' if hs[2] == as_[2] else 'lost to'} "
            f"{a} {as_[0]}.{as_[1]} ({as_[2]})")


def fixture_rows(game: Game, cid: str) -> list[dict]:
    rows = []
    for m in season.club_matches(game, cid):
        home = m["home"] == cid
        opp = m["away"] if home else m["home"]
        row = {"Rd": m["rnd"], "": "H" if home else "A", "Opponent": game.clubs[opp].name,
               "Venue": m["venue"], "Result": "", "Score": "", "ID": m["id"]}
        if m["played"]:
            us, them = (m["hs"], m["as"]) if home else (m["as"], m["hs"])
            row["Result"] = "W" if us[2] > them[2] else "L" if us[2] < them[2] else "D"
            row["Score"] = f"{us[0]}.{us[1]} ({us[2]}) - {them[0]}.{them[1]} ({them[2]})"
        rows.append(row)
    return rows


LEADER_KEYS = {"goals": ("g", "Goals", 1), "disposals": ("disp", "Disposals/game", 5),
               "rating": ("rt", "Avg rating", 5), "votes": ("v", "Brownlow votes", 1),
               "marks": ("m", "Marks/game", 5), "tackles": ("t", "Tackles/game", 5),
               "hitouts": ("ho", "Hit-outs/game", 5), "clearances": ("cl", "Clearances/game", 5)}


def leader_rows(game: Game, what: str = "goals", n: int = 15, club: str | None = None) -> list[dict]:
    key, label, min_default = LEADER_KEYS[what]
    played = max((r["P"] for r in season.ladder(game)), default=0)
    min_games = 1 if min_default == 1 else max(1, int(played * 0.5))
    rows = []
    for i, (val, p) in enumerate(season.leaders(game, key, n, min_games, club)):
        s = p.stats[str(game.year)]
        rows.append({"#": i + 1, "Player": p.name, "Club": p.club or "-", "Pos": p.pos, "Age": p.age,
                     "Gm": s["gm"], label: round(val, 2) if isinstance(val, float) else val})
    return rows


def contract_rows(game: Game, cid: str) -> list[dict]:
    rows = []
    for p in sorted(game.squad(cid), key=lambda p: (p.contract_end, -overall(p))):
        d = offseason.contract_demand(game, p)
        rows.append({"ID": p.id, "Name": p.name, "Pos": p.pos, "Age": p.age, "OVR": ovr(p),
                     "POT": shown_potential(game, p), "List": "Rookie" if p.rookie else "Senior",
                     "Wage": p.wage, "Until": p.contract_end,
                     "Out of contract": "YES" if p.contract_end <= game.year else "",
                     "Asking": d["wage"], "Years": f"{d['min_years']}-{d['max_years']}"})
    return rows


def free_agent_rows(game: Game) -> list[dict]:
    rows = []
    for pid in game.free_agents:
        p = game.players[pid]
        d = offseason.contract_demand(game, p)
        rows.append({"ID": p.id, "Name": p.name, "Pos": "/".join(p.positions), "Age": p.age,
                     "OVR": ovr(p), "POT": shown_potential(game, p),
                     "Asking": int(round(d["wage"] * 1.08 / 5) * 5), "Years": f"{d['min_years']}-{d['max_years']}"})
    rows.sort(key=lambda r: -r["OVR"])
    return rows


def pick_rows(game: Game, cid: str) -> list[dict]:
    return [{"Pick": offseason.pick_label(p), "Code": f"{p['year']}R{p['round']}:{p['orig']}",
             "Est. position": int(round(offseason.pick_number(game, p))),
             "Value": int(round(offseason.pick_value(game, p)))} for p in offseason.club_picks(game, cid)]


def prospect_rows(game: Game, n: int = 40) -> list[dict]:
    rows = []
    for i, p in enumerate(offseason.draft_board(game)[:n]):
        pot = shown_potential(game, p)
        rows.append({"Rank": i + 1, "ID": p.id, "Name": p.name, "Pos": "/".join(p.positions),
                     "Age": p.age, "Ht": p.height, "OVR": ovr(p),
                     "Potential": f"{max(ovr(p), pot - 4)}-{min(99, pot + 4)}"})
    return rows


def finance_rows(game: Game, cid: str) -> list[dict]:
    club = game.clubs[cid]
    order = ["membership", "sponsorship", "afl_distribution", "gate", "prize_money",
             "player_payments", "football_dept", "operations", "contract_payouts"]
    keys = [k for k in order if k in club.ledger] + [k for k in club.ledger if k not in order]
    return [{"Line": k.replace("_", " ").title(), "Last round": club.last_ledger.get(k, 0),
             "Season": club.ledger[k]} for k in keys]


def team_summary(game: Game, cid: str) -> dict:
    """Headline numbers for a club's selected side."""
    club = game.clubs[cid]
    lines = line_ratings(game, cid)
    picked = [game.players[pid] for pid in club.lineup.values() if pid in game.players]
    return {"def": round(lines["D"], 1), "mid": round(lines["M"], 1), "fwd": round(lines["F"], 1),
            "avg_age": round(sum(p.age for p in picked) / max(1, len(picked)), 1),
            "avg_fit": round(sum(p.fitness for p in picked) / max(1, len(picked))),
            "injured": [p for p in game.squad(cid) if p.injury]}


def win_chance(game: Game, m: dict, cid: str) -> float:
    p = finance.win_probability(game, m["home"], m["away"])
    return p if m["home"] == cid else 1 - p
